strapiBlog.title: Esmé Beach Residences Dubai: Elysian Developments’ Grand Entry into Luxury Real Estate
strapiBlog.short_description: Elysian Developments has made its bold entry into the Dubai real estate market with the launch of its inaugural project, Esmé Beach Residences Dubai.

data.text:
Elysian Developments has made its bold entry into the Dubai real estate market with the launch of its inaugural project, Esmé Beach Residences Dubai. Set against the stunning backdrop of Dubai Islands, this AED 370 million development isn’t just another luxury residence—it’s a statement of well-being and modern living. 

Designed to redefine the Dubai luxury property market, Esmé Beach Residences is where functionality meets sophistication, offering a lifestyle that seamlessly blends tranquility with high-end amenities. As the first of many Elysian Developments projects, this visionary venture is set to become a landmark of holistic luxury living in Dubai.

About Elysian Developments

Elysian Developments news has been abuzz with the company's strategic foray into property development. Their inaugural project, Esmé Beach Residences Dubai, stands as a testament to their commitment to crafting communities that emphasize well-being and functionality. This ambitious entry into the Dubai luxury property market is only the beginning, as the developer plans to launch projects worth AED 1 billion in 2025.

Co-founder Masood Naseeb explains, 

"Esmé Beach Residences represents more than just our entry into property development. It is a testament to our expertise, vision, and belief in creating communities that prioritize the well-being of their residents while delivering enduring value."

Partnering with globally recognized Conway and Partners, Elysian Developments has meticulously curated a distinctive brand identity that revolves around the concept of Design for Well-Being.

What to Expect from Esmé Beach Residences?

Spanning an impressive 266,000 sq. ft., Esmé Beach Residences Dubai offers an exclusive collection of 109 meticulously designed one, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. The development seamlessly integrates luxury with wellness-focused features, ensuring that residents experience an unparalleled lifestyle.

Among the standout amenities are:

  • Contrast therapy zones with saunas and cold plunges for rejuvenation
  • A breathtaking rooftop 25-meter lap pool featuring aqua cycling
  • Family pools with poolside cabanas, offering a resort-like atmosphere
  • Cutting-edge fitness centers and outdoor CrossFit zones
  • Purified water systems designed to enhance health and well-being

Why Invest in Esmé Beach Residences Dubai?

With Elysian Developments projects now taking center stage in Dubai’s booming real estate landscape, the company is set to redefine luxury living. The incorporation of holistic wellness into their developments is a game-changer in the Dubai luxury property market.

Co-founder Noman Mahmood elaborates on this strategic approach, stating, 

"Well-being is an integral cornerstone for our business, reflecting the customers’ demand for a holistic and healthy lifestyle. This positioning fulfills the need in the market where well-being is purposefully woven into the architecture and design of our projects."

For those seeking investment opportunities in Dubai real estate, Esmé Beach Residences Dubai offers a compelling proposition. Dubai’s real estate sector continues to attract global investors due to its tax-free incentives, strong rental yields, and continuous infrastructure development.

With a prime waterfront location, innovative wellness-focused architecture, and an impressive portfolio by Elysian Developments, this project is set to deliver long-term value for investors and homeowners alike. As Elysian Developments projects continue to unfold, buyers can expect unparalleled quality and a new benchmark in Dubai’s luxury living segment.

faqs.question: Where are Esmé Beach Residences located?

data.answer: Esmé Beach Residences is situated on the beachside of Island A in the Dubai Islands, offering stunning waterfront views.

faqs.question: Who is the developer of Esmé Beach Residences?

data.answer: The project is developed by Elysian Developments, a rising name in Dubai’s real estate sector known for its focus on wellness and modern living.

faqs.question: What amenities are available at Esmé Beach Residences?

data.answer: Residents can enjoy high-end amenities, including a rooftop lap pool, aqua cycling, contrast therapy zones, family pools, fitness zones, outdoor CrossFit areas, and purified water systems.

faqs.question: Is Esmé Beach Residences a good investment?

data.answer: Yes, given its prime location, luxury features, and Dubai’s thriving property market, Esmé Beach Residences presents excellent investment opportunities in Dubai real estate.

faqs.question: What types of apartments are available at Esmé Beach Residences?

data.answer: The development features 109 residences, including one, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, designed with a focus on modern luxury and wellness.
